name: e2e
description: Browser end-to-end harness. Real browser -> real Next.js -> real NestJS -> real Postgres -> real bcrypt. ADR-041 fixes the seam: only a literal outbound third-party network call may be replaced, and the login flow replaces nothing at all.

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run db:prepare && pnpm run build:apps && playwright test
scripts.test: echo "e2e runs via test:e2e — see ADR-041 for why it is not part of the default suite"
